resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTRADICTS SHEET, not a rounding-level gap: the sheet records Capacity=1800.00 MMcf/d for the 'Zone 3 East-to-West Project' segment (row 3296), but two independent primary sources -- EIA's official pipeline-projects tracker (govt., 'Historical Projects' tab) and Rockies Express Pipeline LLC's own 2015 10-K/financial-statement filing (the project sponsor's primary regulatory disclosure) -- both name this exact project and both state 1.2 million Dth/day (~1200 MMcf/d) of ADDITIONAL firm takeaway capacity created by the project, i.e. 600 MMcf/d (33%) below the recorded 1800.00. Both sources agree with each other precisely (1200 MMcf/d = 1.2 million Dth/d) and neither states or implies 1800. A third source (hydrocarbons-technology.com) could not be checked this pass -- it 403'd on both curl-with-browser-UA and a direct fetch, and the Wayback availability API was rate-limited (429) at the time of the check -- but the two primary sources already in hand (a federal statistical agency + the project company's own SEC filing) meet the 2-independent-source target on their own. Recording as REFS_ADDED (carrying the sheet's existing 1800.00 MMcf/d value, per the owed-a-ref rule) rather than UNRESOLVED because sources WERE found and they agree closely with each other -- but flagging this as a real, material discrepancy for the orchestrator to route to Update: 1800.00 does not match either source found for this specific segment/project and should likely be corrected to 1200 MMcf/d, cited to the two refs above. Note: 1800 MMcf/d IS the correct additional-capacity figure for a DIFFERENT REX project on this same pipeline -- EIA's 'KM REX-East Leg 2' row (2009, Completed) -- so the recorded value may have been carried over from the wrong project/segment row rather than a simple typo.
